title: Resume Builder for Tech Jobs in India: Product Companies, Tier-1 Startups & Campus Hiring
description: How Indian engineering graduates can build ATS-compliant resumes tailored for Indian tech hiring at Flipkart, Swiggy, Zomato, Razorpay, and global MNCs.

image.alt: Resume Builder for Indian Tech Hiring

body:
The Indian tech hiring ecosystem spans three distinct categories: top-tier product companies (Flipkart, Swiggy, Razorpay), global MNC GCCs (Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Cisco, Goldman Sachs), and high-growth venture-backed startups. Each of these categories evaluates candidate resumes against specific criteria.

## 1. What Indian Tech Companies Value on Resumes

- Product Startups: Full-stack capabilities, independent project ownership, live deployment URLs, and deep familiarity with React/Next.js, Node.js/Go, and PostgreSQL.
- Global Product GCCs: Strong fundamentals in Data Structures & Algorithms, LeetCode contest ratings, and clean object-oriented code architecture.
- Mass Recruitment & Service IT: Verified degree requirements, foundational database concepts, and clear communication skills.

## 2. Build Your ATS Resume Free with InternFlow

faq.q: Should I include my LeetCode / Codeforces rating on my resume for Indian tech companies?
faq.a: Yes! If you have solved 200+ LeetCode problems or have a Knight / Guardian rating, listing your profile URL is a powerful signal for Indian tech recruiters.
